subject: SIG & ISO scope clarification — KMS provenance and evidence bundle
messages:
From: Sara Connors <sara.connors@apexbank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Montalvo <alex.montalvo@apexbank.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire + KMS provenance scoping

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our procurement and security teams reviewed Redwood's initial response and we have two immediate asks before we move forward in the RFP:

1) Narrow the scope for KMS/HSM provenance evidence. We need to know exactly which artifacts Redwood can provide for BYO-KMS customers and for Redwood-managed keys (logs, rotation history, attestations).

2) For the SIG questionnaire items related to key management and encryption, can you provide a control mapping (SIG control -> Redwood control/policy -> artifact examples) and an estimate for how long packaging the evidence bundle will take?

We attached the bank's SIG extract (see attached). If you can reply with a concise mapping and a list of deliverables we can share with audit.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Connors
Head of Vendor Risk — Apex Bank
attachments: apex_signal_extract_SIG.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Connors <sara.connors@apexbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + KMS provenance scoping

Sara —

Appreciate the clarity and the extract. We'll scope this into two buckets so your audit team can consume cleanly:

A) Redwood-managed keys (default hosted offering) — we can provide:
- Key lifecycle log excerpts (rotation events) for the past 12 months (redacted where appropriate)
- HSM attestation summary (FIPS 140-2/3 module identifier) and vendor statement
- Control mapping rows for SIG/ISO/SOC2 items that reference key custody, encryption-in-transit, and encryption-at-rest

B) BYO-KMS (customer-provided KMS integrated with Redwood Private/Dedicated) — we will provide:
- Integration architecture diagram and control ownership split (who performs rotation, who holds logs)
- Instructions and artifacts we request from customers for validation (KMS rotation logs, cloud KMS audit entries, HSM attestation if applicable)

I attached a first-pass control mapping (SIG-Control-Mapping-v1.xlsx) and an index file describing the artifact types. We can commit to an evidence bundle for Redwood-managed keys in 10 business days after we get sign-off on the scope and access to the required logs. BYO-KMS evidence depends on customer cooperation (usually 5–12 business days after we receive the customer's artifacts).

Next steps:
- Kim (cc'd) will validate the artifact list and add any technical clarifications for rotation log format.
- Priyom will surface any procurement/legal constraints that change timing (e.g., data access approval).

Would you like a 30-minute sync early next week to confirm the deliverables and evidence format?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
attachments: SIG-Control-Mapping-v1.xlsx (xlsx); evidence-bundle-index.csv (csv)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Connors <sara.connors@apexbank.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + KMS provenance scoping

Hi Sara / Jordan —

Quick technical clarifications and what we'll include in the evidence bundle for Redwood-managed keys:

1) Rotation logs: we'll provide an extract of the KMS rotation log (timestamp, key_id partial, rotation_type, initiated_by, checksum) for the last 12 months. For hosted customers these logs come from our managed HSM layer. Example file: kms-rotation-sample.log (attached).

2) HSM attestation: we'll include the vendor attestation PDF and the FIPS module identifier. See hsm-attestation-2026.pdf (attached). Note: attestation statements vary by HSM vendor — if Apex requires the vendor's detailed lab report we'll need their specific form request (some vendors require direct customer NDA).

3) Control mapping: in SIG-Control-Mapping-v1 we linked the most common SIG items (KMS, KCI, key custody) to Redwood's internal controls. We also marked which controls require customer-supplied evidence under BYO-KMS.

4) Redaction & privacy: rotation logs will be redacted to remove PII and full key material identifiers. If Apex requires unredacted logs for internal auditors, we'll need a signed narrow-scope access agreement and a certified endpoint sink (SFTP or secure SharePoint).

I'll prepare the final evidence bundle layout and aim to have the Redwood-managed package ready in 8 business days once we get the go-ahead.

--
Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
attachments: kms-rotation-sample.log (log); hsm-attestation-2026.pdf (pdf)
From: Alex Montalvo <alex.montalvo@apexbank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + KMS provenance scoping

Jordan / Kim —

Thanks — this is very helpful and much clearer than the first package. A few follow-ups from our audit team after reviewing the mapping and sample artifacts:

- Please include a short example of the KMS API call pattern (GetPublicKey / RotateKey) and the corresponding audit entry header our auditors expect. A sanitized curl example is fine.
- Confirm whether Redwood-managed HSM attestations include the module serial (we understand many vendors redact serials). If serials are redacted, confirm alternative linking methodology (e.g., tag + date + vendor report).
- We will take the 8–10 business day timeline for Redwood-managed evidence. For BYO-KMS we'll track separately and may request a small statement from our infra team describing how we store rotation audit logs; expect a 7–12 day window on that side.

Can we do the 30-minute sync on Wednesday 13 Apr at 10:00am PT? If yes, please send a calendar invite and include the Zoom link (or Redwood meeting room).

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Regards,
Alex Montalvo
Sr. Vendor Risk Analyst — Apex Bank
